text: opus5-9 starting: pin box drag by edges/corners + Windows-style snap zones. Reading pin core and agent 8 reasoning first.

Pin drag+snap works in a real page. Two findings worth flagging: the site's left nav is 232px of opaque chrome painted ABOVE the board, so snapping a pin to left:0 buried half of it, and pinning clamped items under it. Pins now live in viewport-minus-nav, measured live so collapsing the nav gives the width back. Second, my first build positioned the grab ring only on camera changes, so it sat collapsed at 0,0 and still dragged correctly when found. A delta-only assertion sailed past it; the ring-position case catches it.

Done. patch.json: 7 hunks in braindump.js, 1 in braindump.css, every anchor verified unique on disk. tests/board/pin-move-and-snap.test.mjs, 14 cases: red without the patch at 'centre went from 256,250 to 320,286', green with it. pin-to-viewport still 12/12, plus basics 9/9, embed 8/8, theme 7/7, resize-handle-clipping pass, all run against the patched build. Edges and corners MOVE the box; the snap zones do the resizing. Server on 4181. One unrelated finding: resize-handle-clipping.test.mjs writes note-*.md into content/ every run because it never blocks /api/save-markdown.
